function: Learned CSI upsampling at the gNB: recovers full downlink CSI from sparse CSI-RS (and optional virtual pilots) with uplink-CSI-guided aliasing suppression (p. 1-2, 6-8).
system: Massive MIMO FDD: gNB with 8x4 UPA or 32-element ULA, single-antenna UEs, 667 subcarriers at 15 kHz, CSI-RS every 12 subcarriers; carrier frequency not given (p. 8).
method: SRCsiNet: CNN bandpass-filter generator from UL CSI plus SRCNN refinement; SRISTA-Net: ISTA-Net deep unfolding with reciprocity block; supervised end-to-end NMSE training, circular-shift augmentation (p. 6-8, 10).
data_channel: QuaDRiGa with 3GPP TR 38.901 UMa outdoor scenario: 2000 UEs x 16 TTIs = 32,000 channels; 80% training, 10% validation, 10% test (p. 8).
test_conditions: Trained and tested on the same UMa dataset (held-out 10%); test set split into low/medium/high delay-spread clusters; pilot density, virtual pilots and time gaps varied (p. 8-10).
baselines: Linear interpolation and own rule-based UL masking (non-learned); SRCNN [14] and ISTA-Net [26] (learned); DualNet-MP feedback in end-to-end tests (p. 9-10).
metrics: NMSE (dB) of upsampled DL CSI, feedback-only NMSE and end-to-end NMSE, overall and per delay-spread cluster; parameters and FLOPs (p. 8-12).
complexity: Table IV: SRISTA-Net 215K parameters, 2.01 GFLOPs; ISTA-Net 196K, 2 GFLOPs; SRCsiNet 7K, 3.1 MFLOPs; SRCNN 63K, 55.5 MFLOPs (p. 12).
q1_support: p. 8: "The scenario features given in 3GPP TR 38.901" UMa were followed, with the datasets generated by the QuaDRiGa simulator for both training and testing.
q2_support: p. 8: "We used one-tenth of the channels for" testing and validation; the test data are a held-out part of the same QuaDRiGa UMa set (the delay-spread clusters are subsets of it), no other scenario, band or site, no fine-tuning.
q3_support: p. 9: "learning-based SRCsiNet and SR network, SRCNN [14] and" a deep unfolding framework ISTA-Net [26] (learned baselines); p. 10: "SRISTA-Net significantly surpasses other alternatives in" NMSE; linear interpolation (non-learned) is compared in Fig. 10, Fig. 12 and Table I.
q4_support: p. 10: "Table IV outlines the complexity and storage requirements"; Table IV (p. 12) lists parameters and FLOPs, SRISTA-Net 215K and 2.01G, SRCsiNet 7K and 3.1M.
q5_support: p. 8: "datasets using QuaDRiGa channel simulators"; the data are self-generated with a public simulator, and no dataset or code link is given.
notes: Included, area 2: the learned networks upsample the sparsely pilot-sampled downlink CSI to the full CSI at the gNB, as a post-processing step of CSI feedback (p. 1), so the function is channel recovery rather than beamforming. UL Masking is the authors' own non-learned rule-based method (p. 4-5). SRISTA-Net versus ISTA-Net is close to an ablation, but ISTA-Net [26] and SRCNN [14] are standalone published architectures applied to the same problem, so q3 is marked met. The DualNet-MP feedback network appears only in Table I (p. 11) without description. Table III (p. 11) varies the time gap between CSI-RS and virtual pilots, but the text does not say that the model was trained at one gap and tested at another, so q2 stays 0. PDF is the arXiv v1 of 12 Mar 2024.
